card.name: Words right before "command(s)"
card.fires_on: Linking words just before the word command or commands, such as "the following", "additional", "given", "under the". Also the OM inside an all-caps COMMANDS.

modes.label: Lead-in to a command
modes.description: A word like following, given, additional or these placed before command(s) in computer instructions or dog training.
modes.example: To create a username and password, use the<< following>> command: [root@deep ]/# /

modes.label: Military command
modes.description: A word before command in the sense of leading troops.
modes.example: Company B, 34th Virginia Infantry arrived in Petersburg May 1864 as part of Wise’s Brigade, under<< the>> command of P.G.T. Beaure

modes.label: Inside COMMANDS
modes.description: The middle of an all-caps compound name ending in COMMANDS.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word command and away from com- word starts, so it predicts the next word is command(s).
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "command" when the text is about to say command or commands.
